metric.strong: share of pixels whose largest RGB channel difference exceeds 64 after a 3x3 box blur of both images (ImageDiff)
metric.mean: mean largest RGB channel difference without blur, 0-255
metric.heightDifference: native minus Cordova height in device pixels (density 2)

rule: a comparison passes when the widths are equal, strong <= recorded + margin.strong, mean <= recorded + margin.mean and the height difference <= recorded heightDifference + margin.heightDifference
recordedOn: Robolectric 4.17, SDK 34, native graphics, macOS arm64; the references are the screen captures in shell-reference/<lang>
why: Residual differences are glyph rasterization: the emulator's Android 16 fonts against Robolectric's SDK 34 fonts (Korean glyphs up to 1 px narrower) and centered text on whole device pixels. The photo theme's header is white with a grey outline over the white page, so only the mean sees it.
sensitivity: Measured 2026-11-08 by changing the shell one way at a time and rerunning: tab items 1 dp lower, no hairlines and a missing analytics value each fail all 8 screenshot tests; no photo outline fails both photo tests (header mean); menu blocks without the 0.87 opacity fail both dark tests. Missing chevrons and a regular title weight pass the screenshots, so ShellTest checks the menu's rows, values and chevrons; ShellFit catches cut text such as a Japanese or German tab label kept on one line, or a value that does not move under its label, at font scale 1.3.
